10747504.topic_title: 关于 homekit 设备无响应、homepod mini 网络连接中断问题，推荐个路由器
10747504.content:
我用小米,Homekit,原来状态不稳定,延时高.
路由器 asus ac86u, 改下面三项,正常了.
全改了 2.4G 断流消失了.
可能个例,仅供参考
Advanced Settings - Wireless - Professional - Roaming assistant = Disable
Advanced Settings - Wireless - Professional - Airtime Fairness: Disable
Advanced Settings - Wireless - Professional - Universal Beamforming: Disable
Advanced Settings - Administration - System - Basic Config - Enable WAN down browser redirect notice: No
Advanced Settings - Administration - System - USB Setting - USB Mode: USB 3.0 ---> USB 2.0
Advanced Settings - Wireless - General - Wireless Mode: Auto ---> N only
Advanced Settings - Wireless - General - Channel bandwidth: 20/40 MHz ---> 20 MHz
Advanced Settings - Wireless - General - Control Channel: Auto ---> 11
Advanced Settings - Wireless - Professional - Region : The United States
Advanced Settings - Wireless - General - Enable Smart Connect: OFF
